useCases.title: Place an order by card checkout
useCases.quote: - **Fast checkout.** The checkout page lists your items and an order summary with the subtotal, $5 flat shipping and the total. Pay by card and get an order number right away.

useCases.title: Apply a promotion at checkout
useCases.quote: - **Promo codes.** Apply `SAVE10` at checkout and the summary updates with your discount and the new total.

useCases.title: Browse the product catalogue
useCases.quote: - **Browse the catalogue.** Four hand-picked products with prices. Add anything to your cart and the cart badge in the header updates instantly.
